text:
nina-partners: Heads up  new joint GTM with AuroraEdge for CloudStore listing. Target publish Thu 7/11. Need marketplace tile, a short co-announcement blurb, and two localized landing variants (EN/JP).

matt-marketing: Embargo requested Thu 7/11 09:00 PT. I'll need partner-approved quote + CEO quote by Mon EOD. Also a 1-pager for the sales kit.

kevin-creative: I'll create a hero + 3 screenshot comps. Where should I drop them?

zara-se: Integration notes: AuroraEdge SI flow passes smoke tests. Remaining: sample Helm chart and a quickstart snippet for the docs.

omar-legal: Reviewed draft; please remove "fully-managed" phrase unless we add SLA. Also need approved EU data residency wording.

nina-partners: Put assets in /shared/partners/aurora/marketplace and tag me. SKU naming?

matt-marketing: Proposed SKUs: AUR-EDGE-S, AUR-EDGE-S-HWB. Meter slug: aurora.edge.hour. Placeholder pricing OK for listing.

zara-se: Quickstart CLI to include in microsite:

```
rcli deploy --provider=aurora --sku AUR-EDGE-S --region ap-northeast-1
```

kevin-creative: Uploaded hero + comps to /shared/partners/aurora/marketplace at 14:05 PT. JP variant included.

omar-legal: EU residency copy posted: https://docs.example/legal/eu-residency-aurora. Use exact text.

matt-marketing: I'll draft PR and 1-pager tonight and post link here for review.

deploy-bot: Event created: "AuroraEdge CloudStore Rehearsal" Wed 7/10 08:00 PT. link: https://cal.example/aurora-rehearsal

nina-partners: Action recap: Matt  PR + 1-pager (Mon EOD). Kevin  final assets (done). Zara  helm + quickstart (Tue EOD). Omar  legal blurbs (done). Rehearsal Wed 7/10. Flag anything that blocks. :rocket:
